caption:
These are the Core Web Vitals.

LCP (Largest Contentful Paint): when the biggest image or text block appears.
INP (Interaction to Next Paint): the delay between a tap and the screen updating.
CLS (Cumulative Layout Shift): how much things move while loading.

The thresholds are measured at the 75th percentile of real visits, so your slowest users count.

Check any site at pagespeed.web.dev. Try your college website.

Source: web.dev, Web Vitals.

For Best Frontend Resources visit https://allahabadi.dev created by Frontend Master

altText:
Google measures your page's user experience with 3 numbers. "Good" means:

LCP ≤ 2.5 s: main content visible
INP ≤ 200 ms: page responds to taps
CLS ≤ 0.1: layout doesn't jump around
